releases.tagline: Official Release v1 with Tauri v2 Async Engine & Multi-Platform Pipeline
whatsNew: Modern Gemini-inspired Desktop UI with frosted glassmorphism & dual dynamic themes.
Full 4K Ultra HD (2160p) and 2K (1440p) direct downloading pipeline with zero quality loss.
Instant Audio-Only Studio Converter: MP3 (320kbps/192kbps), pristine M4A, and studio WAV.
TikTok No-Watermark high-speed scraper integration with instant CDN link resolver.
Instagram Reels, Carousels, and single video post downloader with automated session header spoofing.
WhatsApp Status Reader for local cache retrieval (Images, Videos, and Voice status).
Automated FFmpeg sidecar muxing for synchronizing high-bitrate separate video & audio streams.
improvementsAndFixes: Migrated core architecture to Tauri v2 Rust for negligible RAM footprint (~35MB idle).
Real-time streaming stdout regex parser with instant ETA, percentage, and MB/s download speed metrics.
Resolved YouTube signature deciphering delay on age-restricted and music videos.
Graceful handling and user-friendly toasts for rate-limiting (HTTP 429), private media, and disk space limits.
Added Git short commit hash build injection for total transparency across dev/production builds.

releases.tagline: Public Beta Testing & FFmpeg Auto-Muxing Engine
whatsNew: Integrated FFmpeg sidecar pipeline for cross-platform container merging (MP4/MKV).
Interactive Queue Management with pause, resume, cancel, and clear completed controls.
Format selector dropdown supporting 1080p, 720p, 480p, and standard audio.
improvementsAndFixes: Fixed Windows UNC path parsing issue when saving files with non-ASCII or emoji titles.
Reduced CPU throttling during multi-part file downloads.
Enhanced error recovery when internet connectivity drops temporarily during large 4K files.
